complete_examples.text: Simultaneously, the tangential creep force is expressed by the Kalker linear creep theory [41] and modified by the Shen–Hedrick–Elkins nonlinear model [42].

The coupling of vehicle and track is implemented by the wheel-rail contact model, which is depicted by the nonlinear Hertz contact theory (Zhai 2015) and Kalker linear creep theory (Kalker 1991), respectively.
The coupling of wheel and rail is described by the nonlinear Hertz contact theory [25] and Kalker linear creep theory [26], respectively.
